messages:
Mia: Heads-up — ran the nightly regression alert, p95 spiked ~18% for convo workload on xlarge-v2.
Can we schedule a quick profiling sweep today? I want microbench + full load profile.

Rajesh: I can run microbench on rtx-dedicated later today. Which model/seq? Also pinging @olivia for tracing hooks.

Olivia: model=redwood-xl-3b-quant, seq=1024 by default. For the spike it's mostly 512-1024. I can add trace spans if you want.

Mia: yes please. Targets:
- TTFT (first-token time) p50/p95
- tok/s under 95th percentile load
- KV-hit ratio from cache
Use the bench runner:
```bash
./tools/run_bench --model redwood-xl-3b-quant --seq 512 --concurrency 16 --runs 100
```
Annotate run with tag `regress-1891`.

Rajesh: noted. I'll run microbench and a 1hr soak on rtx-dedicated with that cmd, tag added.

Sam: Quick Q — where should I pull the dashboards from? Panel ids? I couldn't find the tok/s panel.

Jana: Panel ids in /dashboards/runtime/perf_overview.json — TTFT panel is id=42, tok/s is id=57, p95 summary is id=79. Alert thresholds live in /alerts/ttft_p95.yaml.

Sam: thx

bench-bot: automated-run 1891230000 completed: baseline microbench p95=132ms, tok/s median=320. See /bench-results/1891230000

Rajesh: first microbench done, p95=156ms (local), 18% higher vs baseline. Uploading logs to s3://redwood-bench/regress-1891/

Olivia: I'll attach tracing tomorrow morning (PST). One ask: if we see KV-key churn, can runtime team toggle prefix caching to repro?

Kevin: we should consider canarying a small traffic subset with older quant profile vs new. I'll coordinate with infra for a 5% canary window if bench signals match.

Mia: plan: Rajesh + Olivia produce bench+trace today, Jana to pull dashboard snapshots, Kevin to prep canary. Sam can do regression alert runbook update. Move async; if any blocker ping me.

Rajesh: on it :thumbsup:

Sam: will update runbook, leaving notes in doc: https://docs.internal/redwood/runtime/regressions/regress-1891

Mia: thanks all. Closing loop later today.
